label: FP
reason: The reported XSS paths involve either the session attribute key (which is server-side generated from the class name) or the Cookie name (also derived from class name), neither of which is directly user-controllable via HTTP parameters. The variable 'param', which originates from user input ('request.getParameterValues'), is modified to append '_SafeStuff' (sbxyz41882.append('_SafeStuff')) before being used to construct the username. Since the actual user-supplied value is sanitized/transformed before reaching the HTML output sinks, there is no cross-site scripting vulnerability on the reported paths.

evidence.note: Sink uses 'bar' which contains the safely transformed value, not raw user input
